title: Bananas N' Stuff
description: This beginner-friendly mod adds bananas and a lot of related items and tools! There are new food items that can be crafted from the bananas! There are also 2 new mobs!
body:
### BANANAS N' STUFF
This mod adds bananas and related items!

The Banana food item is currently crafted by 1 leather and 1 yellow dye. There are plans to add a banana tree in the future.

Using the banana, you can craft a banana sword, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe, and shield.

The banana sword deals 5.5 damage, crafted with 1 stick and 2 bananas, just like a normal sword. It had a fast attack speed.

The banana axe deals 8 damage, has an efficiency slightly below iron, and attacks slightly faster than a diamond are

The banana pickaxe acts just like an iron pickaxr, able to mine anything an iron pickaxe can, with slightly less efficiency.

The banana shovel and hoe are just what you'd expect-an average hoe and shovel, with efficiency slightly below iron.

The banana shield acts like a normal shield, with extra durability.

The banana armor protects a bit more than iron armor, but less than diamond

There is also banana pudding, crafted with 2 sugar, 3 bananas, and 1 bowl.

### MOBS

 The bananaman mob has 50 hearts and deals 10 damage, however, he is hostile to most of the other hostile mobs, even though his main target is the player.

 The Banana Raider spawns at the end of raids, dealing 10 damage and having 150 hp. Targets players first, then iron golems, and lastly, villagers.
